evidence.note: Derives theoretical generalization bounds for compute-optimal (Chinchilla-scaling-law) LLM pretraining using a novel empirical Freedman-type martingale concentration inequality, showing larger models have provably smaller generalization gaps because loss variance and quantization error decline with scale even as the parameters-per-token ratio stays fixed.
evidence.title: Compute-Optimal LLMs Provably Generalize Better with Scale

name: quantization error as a generalization factor
